name: clientbooks-hub
description: For accountants and bookkeepers who manage many client orgs; works with Xero. Connect every client under one practice login, then ask across all of them: overdue invoices, payroll risk, client health, practice revenue and DSO, unreconciled lines older than N days, duplicate bills and payments, missing tax codes and GST/VAT anomalies, BAS/VAT and month-close readiness, month-end summaries with draft commentary, and Excel packs. Read-only by default; optional DRAFT-only journals need explicit per-org confirmation. Local audit trail; tokens encrypted at rest.
